address: Masía L'Hort de Fortunyo, Arnes, 43597, Spain
bio: This restaurant is part of the rural L'Hort de Fortunyo hotel, a delightful stone farmhouse the origins of which date back to the 18C and which is surrounded by olive trees close to the Parque Natural de Els Ports. The honest cuisine served here, which respects the traditions of the Terra Alta area but with a contemporary touch and a nod to recipes from elsewhere, is always based around ingredients grown in its own vegetable garden. The terrace is particularly delightful!...
